answer_1.quote: To build sufficient paraphrases, we adopt AESOP, a syntactically controllable paraphrasing model generating paraphrases by specifying pruned target syntactic trees that can be sampled diversely.

answer_2.quote: The CaRB Metric. To evaluate the correctness of system tuples, CaRB first creates an all-pair matching table... computes precision and recall scores in each cell.

answer_4.quote: We perform a thorough paraphrase annotation with three types of corrections... based on human experts... All annotators undergo training with tutorials...
answer_4.guideline: Grammar Correcting: Correct grammatical mistakes in sentences to ensure the fluency. Phrase Replacing: Replace the incorrect phrases in sentences to ensure the correctness. Sentence Rewriting: Rewrite the entire sentence if it has a semantic difference from the original sentence.
